receipts.concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: ObservedMeleeStart pairs MeleeAttackKey identity and AnimationSampleTick time from one native observed word; equal underlying u64 does not make roles redundant. Delayed contact/start/end are sample coordinates, durations convert to AnimationSampleSpan. The helper deliberately distinguishes minimum-one duration spans from zero-valid arrival spans.
receipts.disposition: Preserve attack identity independently of delayed sample coordinates and preserve tick/span/CombatDuration distinctions. This prevents using delayed contact as attack identity or adding sample coordinates as duration. Shared native quantization is not duplicate authority. minimum_one is local rounding policy with actual different consumers; no mandatory extra wrapper suggested absent concrete mix-up. Numerical saturation/representability remains other-lens admission/operation obligation, not cleared by granularity. Existing tests read only.

receipts.disposition: Preserve explicit recovery outcome and distinct physical roles beneath any shared checked leaves; zero weapon workload/unarmed values are legitimate and human mass bounds must not constrain generic item/creature mass. No separate fatigue pool or direct fatigue performance path is introduced; actual source reads total incapacitation. Support inherited M01/P16 physical/source/operation propagation, no new unique finding or runtime pass.
